status: adversarial research; continuous approximation, not consensus code

log_coordinate_nonexpansion.statement: A qualifier-selection outcome differs by at most one nat in each frontier coordinate, and common clipped transitions do not enlarge it.

direct_maximal_pair_monte_carlo.model: rare-crossing fixed-target maximal e-separated state pair

refuted_4_300_boundary_calculation.interpretation: Refuted boundary-state calculation retained for provenance; it is neither an upper bound nor a realistic attack estimate.
refuted_4_300_boundary_calculation.reason: Boundary-state reset does not dominate every interior paired state; the calculation is retained as falsified evidence, not used in verdict.

target_uniform_continuous_model_bound.scope: continuous uniform-PoW epoch-min model, including a common target chosen adaptively before each epoch; divergent counterfactual target paths and exact integer/discrete lift remain open
target_uniform_continuous_model_bound.proof_method: piecewise-affine transition case split plus conditional log-depth density ratio f_p(q+t)/f_p(q)>=exp(-t)

pathwise_bound.note: Arbitrarily long positive-probability reward/reset paths exist; the finite bound is in expectation, matching the task's criterion.

long_run_classification.constant_or_eventual_plateau: asymptotic order-statistic model: lambda=O(1/n), multiple-qualifier opportunities O(1/n^2) and summable; simulations are finite-horizon
